svg.title: Known-best packing of 204 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=204 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-16 exact rational corner certificates at 127, 204, 232, 264 and 305, read exactly from the retained source files n-NNN-candidate.yaml at bc10ce4 in JonathanGun/square-packing-upper-bounds, the commit jlevy/squares#1001 named when filed, whose tree 0aac839e re-commits: JoeGun's improvements of Tomas Kodaj's public Kaggle packings, their exact coordinates made by this repository's packing-witness promote. Finite construction feasibility only; local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.
